correctness.rationale: Exact enumeration of independent vertex sets gives face-cardinality counts (1,20,160,660,1510,1912,1240,320,5). The cited verifier gives mod-2 boundary ranks (19,141,519,991,921,315,5) for nontrivial boundaries. Mod-two Betti ranks bound rational Betti ranks, and reduced Euler characteristic -4 forces rational H5 rank four and vanishing elsewhere, without claiming torsion absence. The Hopf trace formula on augmented chains gives tr_H5(g)=sum_{fixed sets S}(-1)^|S|sgn(g|S). Independent reconstruction enumerated all 120 graph automorphisms and all fixed independent face sets and exactly reproduced epsilon(g)(#Fix_I(g)-1), with 60 elements of each orientation and 60 even induced permutations on the five maxima. Equality of rational finite-group characters gives the module isomorphism. This is an exhaustive finite calculation, not sampled inference.
